value.rationale: The theorem classifies a natural complete family of chain-graph/Ferrers valuations by a specific depth-indexed algebraic invariant, with a phase-parity phenomenon when the numbers of neighborhood types differ. It reduces all shapes and multiplicities to only two integers and gives sharp formulae at each depth, rather than a few special-case counts. The extension beyond the earlier square case is substantial because both zero-row and zero-column boundary regimes and arbitrary duplicate classes are handled uniformly. It supplies exact modal-refinement benchmarks and generated-subalgebra sizes without pretending to solve general generation.
